editorial.blurb: La Esperanza is a cozy Pilsen institution where the mole—velvety, complex, and award-winning—elevates every dish it touches, and the staff treats you like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the mole enchiladas and don't rush; the sauce is built to linger on every bite. If you're vegan, ask about their dedicated vegan menu—the dairy-free mole enchiladas and flautas are celebration-worthy.
